blocks.text: Joy predloglari: next to, between, behind, under ...

Narsaning aniq qayerda turganini aytish uchun o'zbek tilida **ko'makchilar** ishlatiladi: stol **ostida**, uy**ning orqasida**, bank **bilan** pochta **orasida**, maktab**ning ro'parasida**. Tartib: avval ot, keyin ko'makchi. Ingliz tilida esa tartib teskari — avval predlog, keyin ot: **under** the table, **behind** the house, **between** the bank **and** the post office, **opposite** the school. O'zbekchadagi `-ning` qo'shimchasi inglizchaga «of» bo'lib o'tmaydi: «behind of the house» emas, **behind the house**.

**next to** (rasmiyroq — **beside**) — «bevosita yonida», orada boshqa narsa yo'q: the chair **next to** the window. **by** ham «yonida, chetida» degan ma'noni beradi, ayniqsa deraza, eshik, daryo, dengiz bilan: **by** the window, **by** the sea. **near** esa «yaqinida» — masofa kichik, lekin yonma-yon bo'lishi shart emas: We live **near** the park (park yaqinida — ehtimol, ikki ko'cha narida). O'zbekchada «yonida» ba'zan ikkala ma'noda ishlatiladi, inglizchada farqlang.

items.text: The fridge is **next to** the cooker.
Is there a supermarket **near** your flat?
We sat **by** the fire and talked for hours.

blocks.text: between, in front of, behind, opposite

**between** — ikki narsa orasida: **between** A **and** B. O'zbekchada «A **bilan** B orasida» deymiz, shuning uchun «between A with B» degan xato uchraydi — inglizchada doim **and**. **in front of** — «oldida», **behind** — «orqasida»; ular bir-biriga qarama-qarshi. **opposite** — «ro'parasida»: yuzma-yuz, odatda ko'cha, stol yoki xonaning **narigi tomonida**. Farqni his qiling: navbatda sizdan oldin turgan odam — **in front of** you; stolning narigi tomonida sizga qarab o'tirgan odam — **opposite** you.

items.text: The pharmacy is **between** the bank **and** the bakery.
There's a small car park **behind** the hotel.
Kamola sat **opposite** me, and her husband sat **next to** her.
items.translation: Kamola mening **ro'paramda**, eri esa uning **yonida** o'tirdi.

blocks.text: **under** — «ostida, tagida»: ko'pincha narsa bevosita pastda, ba'zan ust tomoni bilan yopilgan: **under** the table, **under** the bed, **under** a tree. **below** — «pastida, quyida», ya'ni pastroq darajada: **below** the window, **below** zero. **above** — «tepasida, yuqorisida», lekin **tegmasdan**: a lamp **above** the table. Agar tegib tursa — **on** (106-dars). **over** ham «ustida», lekin ko'pincha ustini qoplaganda yoki ustidan o'tganda: a bridge **over** the river, a blanket **over** the baby (harakat ma'nosi — 110-dars).

items.text: Our shoes are **under** the bench in the hall.
There's a light **above** the front door.
In winter it's often **below** zero in Tashkent.
items.translation: Qishda Toshkentda harorat ko'pincha nol**dan past** bo'ladi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «under of the table» / «behind of the house» → **under the table** / **behind the house** (`-ning` → «of» emas); lekin **in front of** da **of** shart: «in front the house» → **in front of the house**; «next of» → **next to**; «between Aziz with Madina» → **between Aziz and Madina**; «The lamp is on the table» (osilib turgan bo'lsa) → **above the table**; «in the front of the bank» (bino oldida) → **in front of the bank**.

Ikki predlog «yordamchi» so'z bilan keladi: **in front of**, **next to**. Qolganlari yolg'iz: **behind**, **under**, **opposite**, **between** (... **and** ...), **above**, **below**, **near**, **by**. Olmosh bilan — object shakli: **behind me**, **next to her**, **opposite them** (59-dars).
Bog'lanish: in / at / on (joy) — 106–107-darslar; harakat yo'nalishi: under, over, through, across — 110-dars; me / him / her / them — 59-dars.

items: **between** A **and** B — A bilan B orasida;
**in front of** — oldida ↔ **behind** — orqasida; **opposite** — ro'parasida (narigi tomonda, yuzma-yuz);
**under** — ostida, tagida; **below** — pastida; **above** — tepasida (tegmasdan); **over** — ustida, ustini yopib;
predlog otdan **oldin** keladi va «of» faqat **in front of** da bor.

examples.title: **next to**, **beside**, **by**
examples.description: Bevosita yonida — **next to** (= **beside**): the chair **next to** the door. **by** ham «yonida, bo'yida»: by the window, by the river.

sentences.text: Can I sit **next to** you?
The post office is **next to** the bank.
Madina always sits **by** the window in class.
There's a lovely café **by** the river where we often have lunch.
sentences.translation: Daryo **bo'yida** ajoyib kafe bor, biz u yerda ko'pincha tushlik qilamiz.

sentences.text: Who's the tall man standing **beside** Tom?
sentences.translation: Tom**ning yonida** turgan baland bo'yli odam kim?

sentences.text: Put the lamp **next to** the bed, not on the desk.
sentences.translation: Chiroqni yozuv stoliga emas, karavot **yoniga** qo'ying.

sentences.text: In the photo, I'm the one **next to** my grandfather.
Our house is the white one **next to** the mosque.
Bekzod parked his car **by** the gate and went inside.
sentences.translation: Bekzod mashinasini darvoza **yonida** qoldirib, ichkariga kirdi.

sentences.text: At the wedding, I sat **next to** an old lady who told me funny stories all evening.
sentences.translation: To'yda bir keksa ayol**ning yonida** o'tirdim, u kechqurun bo'yi menga kulgili voqealarni gapirib berdi.

examples.title: **near**: close, but not right next to
examples.description: **near** — «yaqinida»: masofa kichik, lekin yonma-yon bo'lishi shart emas. **next to** — «yonida, yonma-yon». «near to» shart emas, **near** yetarli.

sentences.text: Do you live **near** here?
We stayed in a hotel **near** the beach.
Is there a pharmacy **near** the station?
My school was so **near** my house that I could walk there in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Maktabim uyim**ga** shunchalik **yaqin** ediki, u yerga besh daqiqada piyoda borardim.

sentences.text: Aziz's village is **near** Samarkand, about thirty kilometres away.
sentences.translation: Azizning qishlog'i Samarqand **yaqinida**, taxminan o'ttiz kilometr narida.

sentences.text: Don't stand so **near** the edge — it's dangerous!
The flat isn't **next to** the metro, but it's quite **near** it.
sentences.translation: Kvartira metro**ning yonida** emas, lekin unga ancha **yaqin**.

sentences.text: Are there any good restaurants **near** your office?
Sarah grew up in a small town **near** Oxford.
Come and sit **near** the fire — you look cold.
sentences.translation: Olov**ga yaqinroq** kelib o'tiring — sovqotganga o'xshaysiz.

examples.title: **between** ... **and** ...
examples.description: Ikki narsa orasida — **between A and B**. O'zbekchada: A **bilan** B **orasida**. «between A with B» emas — doim **and**.

sentences.text: The bank is **between** the café **and** the bookshop.
Bukhara is **between** Samarkand **and** Khiva.
In the photo, Madina is standing **between** her two brothers.
sentences.translation: Suratda Madina ikki akasi**ning o'rtasida** turibdi.

sentences.text: We've got a small garden **between** the house **and** the road.
Who's sitting **between** Tom **and** Emma?
The cat is hiding **between** the sofa **and** the wall.
I found my passport **between** the pages of an old book.
A river runs **between** the two villages.
Our seats were **between** two very noisy families, so we couldn't hear the film.
sentences.translation: O'rindiqlarimiz ikkita juda shovqinli oila**ning o'rtasida** edi, shuning uchun filmni eshita olmadik.

sentences.text: Can you see the little shop **between** the pharmacy **and** the bakery? That's where my uncle works.
sentences.translation: Dorixona **bilan** novvoyxona **orasidagi** kichik do'konni ko'ryapsizmi? Amakim o'sha yerda ishlaydi.

examples.title: **in front of** and **behind**
examples.description: **in front of** — «oldida», **behind** — «orqasida». **in front of** da **of** bor, **behind** da esa yo'q («behind of» emas).

sentences.text: There's a big tree **in front of** our house.
The garage is **behind** the house.
A tall man was sitting **in front of** me at the cinema, so I couldn't see.
sentences.translation: Kinoda **oldimda** baland bo'yli odam o'tirgan edi, shuning uchun ko'ra olmadim.

sentences.text: Who's that hiding **behind** the door?
Let's meet **in front of** the theatre at seven.
The sun went **behind** a cloud, and it suddenly got cold.
sentences.translation: Quyosh bulut **orqasiga** kirdi va birdan sovuq bo'lib ketdi.

sentences.text: Please don't park **in front of** the gate.
In the queue, Aziz was **behind** me and Bekzod was **in front of** me.
The children were taking photos **in front of** the Registan.
You can park **behind** the supermarket — it's easy to find a space there.
sentences.translation: Supermarket**ning orqasida** mashina qo'yishingiz mumkin — u yerda joy topish oson.

examples.title: **opposite**: facing, on the other side
examples.description: **opposite** — «ro'parasida, qarshisida»: yuzma-yuz, ko'cha yoki stolning narigi tomonida. **in front of** — oldida (bir tomonda).

sentences.text: The bank is **opposite** the park.
There's a new pharmacy **opposite** our school.
At dinner, Sarah sat **opposite** me, so we talked all evening.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatda Sara mening **ro'paramda** o'tirdi, shuning uchun kechqurun bo'yi gaplashdik.

sentences.text: Who lives in the house **opposite** yours?
sentences.translation: Sizning uyingiz**ning ro'parasidagi** uyda kim yashaydi?

sentences.text: The bus stop is **opposite** the hospital, on the other side of the road.
sentences.translation: Bekat shifoxona**ning ro'parasida**, yo'lning narigi tomonida.

sentences.text: Tom's car is **in front of** his house, and mine is **opposite** it.
sentences.translation: Tomning mashinasi uyi**ning oldida**, meniki esa uning **ro'parasida**.

sentences.text: Our hotel was right **opposite** the train station.
Can you see the mosque? The shop is just **opposite** it.
Dilnoza and her sister live **opposite** each other on the same street.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza va opasi bitta ko'chada bir-biri**ning ro'parasida** yashashadi.

sentences.text: Every morning I see the same old man in the café **opposite** my office.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab ofisim**ning ro'parasidagi** kafeda o'sha keksa odamni ko'raman.

examples.title: **under** and **below**
examples.description: **under** — «ostida, tagida»: under the table, under the bed. **below** — «pastida, quyida» (pastroq darajada): below the window, below zero. **under** yosh bilan — «... dan kichik».

sentences.text: The dog is sleeping **under** the table.
I found my missing sock **under** the bed.
The temperature last night was ten degrees **below** zero.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi harorat nol**dan** o'n daraja **past** edi.

sentences.text: Write your answer **below** the question.
Children **under** six don't pay on the metro.
sentences.translation: Olti yosh**dan kichik** bolalar metroda pul to'lamaydi.

sentences.text: We sat **under** a big tree and had our picnic in the shade.
sentences.translation: Katta daraxt **tagida** o'tirib, soyada piknik qildik.

sentences.text: The family who lives **below** us has a new baby.
sentences.translation: Bizning **pastimizda** yashaydigan oilada yangi chaqaloq tug'ildi.

sentences.text: Is your bag **under** your seat?
From the plane we could see the whole city **below** us.
Aziz keeps his old football boots in a box **under** the stairs.
sentences.translation: Aziz eski butsalarini zinapoya **tagidagi** qutida saqlaydi.

examples.title: **above** and **over**; **on** or **above**?
examples.description: **above** — «tepasida» (tegmasdan): a lamp above the table. **on** — yuzaga tegib turibdi. **over** — ustida, ko'pincha ustini yopib yoki ustidan o'tib: a bridge over the river.

sentences.text: There's a mirror **above** the sink.
Our flat is **above** a small bakery.
The plane is flying **above** the clouds now.
The lamp isn't **on** the table — it's hanging **above** it.
sentences.translation: Chiroq stol **ustida** emas — uning **tepasida** osilib turibdi.

sentences.text: An old stone bridge goes **over** the river near our village.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imiz yaqinida daryo **ustidan** eski tosh ko'prik o'tgan.

sentences.text: Madina put a blanket **over** the sleeping baby.
sentences.translation: Madina uxlab yotgan chaqaloq**ning ustiga** adyol yopdi.

sentences.text: The mountains are 3,000 metres **above** sea level.
Who lives in the flat **above** yours?
sentences.translation: Sizning kvartirangiz**ning tepasidagi** kvartirada kim yashaydi?

sentences.text: In summer the temperature in Termez is often **above** forty degrees.
sentences.translation: Yozda Termizda harorat ko'pincha qirq daraja**dan yuqori** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Bekzod's office is **above** a dentist's, so he often hears the drill.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning ofisi tish shifoxonasi**ning tepasida**, shuning uchun u ko'pincha burg'u ovozini eshitadi.

examples.title: Mixed: describing a street and a room
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: next to, between, in front of, behind, opposite, under, above, near — ko'cha va xonani tasvirlash.

sentences.text: On our street, the baker's is **next to** a small mosque.
**Opposite** the mosque there's a park with a fountain.
My grandparents' house is **between** the park **and** the school.
There's an old apricot tree **in front of** their house.
sentences.translation: Ularning uyi **oldida** keksa o'rik daraxti bor.

sentences.text: **Behind** the house there's a big garden full of roses.
sentences.translation: Uy**ning orqasida** atirgulga to'la katta bog' bor.

sentences.text: In my room, the desk is **under** the window.
**Above** the desk there's a shelf with all my favourite books.
sentences.translation: Stol**ning tepasida** sevimli kitoblarim turgan javon bor.

sentences.text: My bed is **opposite** the door, and there's a small lamp **next to** it.
sentences.translation: Karavotim eshik**ning ro'parasida**, uning **yonida** esa kichik chiroq bor.

sentences.text: Where's the cat? — Probably **under** the bed or **behind** the sofa.
sentences.translation: Mushuk qayerda? — Ehtimol, karavot **tagida** yoki divan **orqasida**.

sentences.text: The best thing about the flat is that it's **near** the metro but very quiet.
sentences.translation: Kvartiraning eng yaxshi tomoni — u metro**ga yaqin**, lekin juda jim.
